title: Enhancing Road Coordination Through Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) Communication
summary: OptM describes controlled road pilots of its AI vehicle-to-vehicle coordination system; the company has published no result on safety, traffic or emissions.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: In June 2025 OptM described controlled road pilots of vehicle-to-vehicle communication with AI coordination. The company expects safer journeys, smoother traffic and lower emissions. OptM has published no result from the road pilots. On 25 July 2026 the company announced that the Karnataka government had selected it for grant support under ELEVATE NxT 2026. The grant supports a defense platform for unmanned ground vehicles that uses encrypted vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication.
purpose: Help vehicles coordinate safely on constrained roads.

ratings.reason: Drivers and other road users are intended to gain safer road coordination.
Smoother traffic and lower emissions are intended, without a measured public outcome.
